language: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) for output content, Python for extraction scripts
build_system: None - this is a content repository. Files are markdown documents.
test_framework: None - content verification is manual review
build_command: N/A - markdown files, no build needed
verification_instructions: 1. Verify all output markdown files exist in productivity_boost/ folder. 2. Verify content is written in Indonesian. 3. Verify textbook structure (chapters, learning objectives, exercises). 4. Verify all 5 source books are represented.
setup_instructions: pip install PyPDF2 pdfplumber ebooklib beautifulsoup4 (already installed)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available. PDF/EPUB extraction libraries installed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing naming convention: numbered files (e.g., 003-xxx.md). Content in Indonesian language.
key_patterns: Existing files in productivity_boost use numbered markdown files with Indonesian content. Structure includes headers, tables, code blocks, and bullet points.
directory_structure: productivity_boost/ contains markdown educational content and source PDF/EPUB books. The textbook output will be a large markdown file (or multiple parts) in this same directory.

book1.title: The Science of Managing Our Digital Stuff
book1.topics: Personal Information Management (PIM), digital curation, keeping/management/exploitation of files, folders vs search vs tags, user-subjective approach to PIM design

book2.title: Prompt Engineering For LLMs: The Art And Science Of Building Large Language Model Based Applications
book2.topics: LLM fundamentals, understanding LLMs (tokens/temperature/transformers), chat models, RLHF, designing LLM applications, prompt content, assembling prompts, taming the model, conversational agency, LLM workflows, evaluation, multimodality

book3.title: The 4-Hour Body: An Uncommon Guide to Rapid Fat-Loss, Incredible Sex, and Becoming Superhuman
book3.topics: Minimum Effective Dose (MED), self-experimentation methodology, rapid learning, body optimization, sleep engineering, habit formation, data-driven personal improvement

book4.title: Introduction to Algorithms (4th Edition)
book4.authors: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein
book4.topics: Algorithm design and analysis, sorting, data structures, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, NP-completeness, machine learning algorithms, parallel algorithms

book5.title: Modern Data Protection: Ensuring Recoverability of All Modern Workloads
book5.topics: Data backup/recovery, disaster recovery, 3-2-1 rule, deduplication, cloud protection, ransomware defense, archive vs backup, modern data sources (containers/Kubernetes/SaaS), DPaaS
